app.name: DSE + IELTS English Coach
app.tagline: Master reading, writing, listening and speaking with instant AI feedback.

marketing.faqBlurb: Practice HKDSE and IELTS English with AI feedback, multilingual support, and exam-accurate scoring across all four skills.
marketing.heroSubtitle: Practice all four skills with realistic papers, exam-accurate scoring, and AI feedback that explains every point.
marketing.feature1Body: Dedicated DSE and IELTS (Academic & General) tracks with their own rubrics.
marketing.feature2Body: Deterministic scoring plus clear strengths, mistakes, and next steps.
marketing.feature3Body: Full interface in English, Traditional and Simplified Chinese.
